key_points: Robert Hunter appointed president of UnitedHealthcare, leading a leadership reset aimed at margin recovery and modernization.
Improved medical care ratio is lifting the 2026 earnings outlook.
Management signals margin recovery and expects double‑digit bottom‑line growth in the upcoming Q3 earnings.
Stock price has lagged fundamentals, trading near its 10‑year median valuation, suggesting upside if recovery continues.
Dividend remains steady; long‑term earnings growth has persisted despite flat stock performance over the past five years.
